description: Opera Neon, an agentic browser, through the installer Opera's site serves, found by its bundle id.
why: The bundle id is Opera Neon's only value on macOS, and it is read two ways: off the installed app, and off a running one. The installer starts the browser, so setup.sh stops it, and forbid_rows holds that no `proc` row carries the id: must_find then rests on the `app` row, which require_rows names. Nothing is forbidden: the install writes no catalogued agent's lookalike, and test/test_matcher.py declines Opera's other bundle ids.
known_gaps: A match says Opera Neon is installed, not that Neon Do ran or a subscription is active: no route reads either.
Stopped before the query, so running_apps is not exercised for Opera Neon.
Opera's 2017 concept browser, also called Neon, may carry the same bundle id. No run has installed one, and a match on it would read as this agent.
